# Agent Skills
> Public SKILL.md set. Copy one folder. 487 unique. 12 works-verified. Untested ≠ works.

AGENTS.md — 30-second boot for coding agents (start here)
README.md — human install (clone once, copy one folder)
docs/WORKS_VERIFIED.md — rate/install these 12 first
docs/QUALITY.md — ranking method; not a claim all 487 work
docs/CATALOG.md — what/how lookup by tag; not the landing page
docs/INCLUSION.md — include/exclude + works-bar
docs/VALUE_FRAMEWORK.md — scorecard dimensions
docs/QUALITY_IMPROVE.md — below-A playbook (maintainers)
NOTICE — provenance; not every body is original
CONTRIBUTING.md — PRs; sibling folders only
SECURITY.md — reporting + sanitize rules
